question.text: For Cat III AIFs in IFSC, Income Tax Act 1961 imposes:

answer.text: Source-based taxation on non-residents (receive/arising/deemed in India)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.7, Income Tax Act imposes source-based taxation; non-resident income received/accrued/deemed in India is taxable. **The Trap:** Other claims don't match source-based framework. **Cross-Exam Context:** Drives offshore-investor tax treatment. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Clarify source-basis vs residence-basis tax with foreign investors upfront.
